name: sevenseg_counter
description: Loadable hexadecimal counter with seven-segment output decoding.

bit_roles.role: Value loaded by the load control.

ports.name: uo_out
ports.role: Seven-segment pattern on [6:0]; bit [7] is zero.

ports.name: uio_in
ports.role: Auxiliary input bus; unused by this design.

ports.name: uio_out
ports.role: Upper eight bits of the internal counter.

ports.name: uio_oe
ports.role: Auxiliary output-enable mask; all bits are driven.

ports.name: ena
ports.role: Design activity enable; state updates only while asserted.

expected_behavior: Loads the low counter nibble when ui_in[4] is high.
Increments the counter at a divided rate when ui_in[5] is high and emits its low nibble as a seven-segment pattern.
